subject: lavaan 0.6-17 has been released on CRAN

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: lavaan 0.6-17 has been released on CRAN
parts:
Dear all,

A new update of lavaan (0.6.17) is now available on CRAN. This release
fixes the following bugs/issues:

- efa() did not work with sample.cov= (instead of data=)

- group.equal= did not work properly in multigroup-multilevel models

- summary(fit, rsquare = TRUE) failed in some settings

- lavTestScore() + epc = TRUE produced epc values with the wrong sign if
the estimator was not ML

- factor scores for categorical data were not correctly scaled when
parameterization = “theta”

- in 0.6-16 only: multilevel results were sometimes slightly off, if
some variables were within-only

- lav_data_update_subset() (only used in sam()) did not recompute @nobs
if empty cases were present in (the subset of) the data

New features and user-visible changes:

- summary() and parameterEstimates() will now (per default) remove
unused rows corresponding to parameters that are automatically added,
but still fixed to their default values; add remove.unused = FALSE to
get them back

This is most visible when data is categorical: the fixed-to-zero
intercepts and the fixed-to-one scaling factors are no longer printed by
default.

- the default arguments of the sem/cfa/growth function (for example
int.ov.free, int.lv.free) can now be changed when using the
sem/cfa/growth functions

This implies that you can use (say) sem(model, data = Data,
meanstructure = TRUE, int.ov.free = FALSE, int.lv.free = TRUE),
overwriting the default setting of the sem() function.

- requesting estimator = “WLSMV” (or “DWLS”) without categorical data
now produces a warning

- estimator = “PML” now supports sampling weights (thanks to Haziq Jamil)

- modindices() now warns if equality constraints are involved

- lavPredict() gains a mdist= argument to compute casewise Mahalanobis
distances for factor scores and/or casewise residualss

The latter allows to create a diagnostic plot not unlike the plots shown
in Yuan & Hayashi (2010). The function below (not included in lavaan
yet, based on code written by Maxwell Mansolf) illustrates how this can
be done as a proof-of-concept.

Yves.




lavPlotDiagnostics <- function(lavobject, type = "mdist.fs.resid", block
= 1L,
alpha = 0.01, nlabel = 5L, ...) {

type <- tolower(type)
if(!type %in% c("mdist.fs.resid", "qchi.mdist.resid")) {
stop("lavaan ERROR: type= must be mdist.fs.resid or
qchi.mdist.resid")
}

lavmodel <- lavobject@Model

if(type == "mdist.fs.resid") {

# Bartlett factor scores
out.fs <- lavPredict(lavobject, type = "lv", method = "Bartlett",
mdist = TRUE, drop.list.single.group = FALSE)
mdist.fs <- sqrt(attr(out.fs, "mdist")[[block]])
nfac <- ncol(out.fs[[block]])

# casewise residuals
out.resid <- lavPredict(lavobject, type = "resid", method =
"Bartlett",
mdist = TRUE, drop.list.single.group = FALSE)
mdist.resid <- sqrt(attr(out.resid, "mdist")[[block]])
nvar <- ncol(out.resid[[block]])

# critical values
df.fs <- nfac
df.resid <- nvar - nfac
qf <- sqrt(qchisq((1 - alpha), df.fs))
qr <- sqrt(qchisq((1 - alpha), df.resid))

# scatter plot
XLIM <- range(c(mdist.fs[ is.finite(mdist.fs)], qf)) *
c(1,1.05)
YLIM <- range(c(mdist.resid[is.finite(mdist.resid)], qr)) *
c(1,1.05)
plot(mdist.fs, mdist.resid,
xlim = XLIM, ylim = YLIM,
xlab = "M-distance factor scores (leverage)",
ylab = "M-distance casewise residuals (outliers)",
...)

# critical lines
abline(v = qf)
abline(h = qr)

# add points close to the line
qr2 <- qr - 0.05
qf2 <- qf - 0.05
# bottom right: leverage points (but not outliers)
idx <- which(mdist.fs >= qf2 & mdist.resid < qr2)
if(length(idx) > 0L) {
text(x = mdist.fs[idx], mdist.resid[idx],
labels = as.character(idx), pos = 4L, col = "darkgreen")
}

# top left: potential outliers (but not leverage observations)
idx <- which(mdist.resid >= qr2 & mdist.fs < qf2)
if(length(idx) > 0L) {
text(x = mdist.fs[idx], mdist.resid[idx],
labels = as.character(idx), pos = 4L, col = "darkgreen")
}

# top right: both outliers and leverage points
idx <- which(mdist.fs >= qf2 & mdist.resid >= qr2)
if(length(idx) > 0L) {
text(x = mdist.fs[idx], mdist.resid[idx],
labels = as.character(idx), pos = 4L, col = "red")
}
} # type = "mdist.fs.resid"

else if(type == "qchi.mdist.resid") {

# Bartlett factor scores
out.fs <- lavPredict(lavobject, type = "lv", method = "Bartlett",
mdist = TRUE, drop.list.single.group = FALSE)
# mdist.fs <- sqrt(attr(out.fs, "mdist")[[block]])
nfac <- ncol(out.fs[[block]])

# casewise residuals
out.resid <- lavPredict(lavobject, type = "resid", method =
"Bartlett",
mdist = TRUE, drop.list.single.group = FALSE)
mdist.resid <- sqrt(attr(out.resid, "mdist")[[block]])
nvar <- ncol(out.resid[[block]])

# sort casewise residuals
out <- sort.int(mdist.resid, index.return = TRUE)
mdist.resid.sorted <- out$x

# (squared) chisq quantiles
qq <- sqrt(qchisq(ppoints(length(mdist.resid)), df = nvar - nfac))

# scatter plot
XLIM <- range(qq) * c(1, 1.05)
YLIM <- range(mdist.resid[is.finite(mdist.resid)]) * c(1, 1.05)
plot(qq, mdist.resid.sorted,
xlim = XLIM, ylim = YLIM,
xlab = "Quantiles of (squared) chi-squared distribution",
ylab = "M-distance casewise residuals (outliers)",
...)

# label 'nlabel' largest residuals
N <- length(mdist.resid.sorted)
x.idx <- (N - nlabel + 1L):N
y.idx <- out$ix[x.idx]
if(nlabel > 0L) {
text(x = qq[x.idx], y = mdist.resid[y.idx],
labels = as.character(y.idx), pos = 3L)
}
} # plot == qchi.mdist.resid

invisible()
}
